m0-context.imperative: Verify handoff is complete: task, intent, allowed scope, specific exclusions, required evidence, test mode, stop conditions, return format — all present. Read AUDIT_MAP.md seams. Attest c1.

m1-friction-verify.title: VERIFY friction_coupling is never invoked, then remove it
m1-friction-verify.imperative: Grep for .friction_coupling. (dot-method calls) in all src. If invoked: STOP and report. Remove G_MS2 from braking_fit.py (replace definition with deprecation-import comment or just remove). Add class-level docstring note about units. 2. In LongitudinalParameters: add unit comment on theta_P_values field stating 'W/kg (specific power, m²/s³)'. 3. In car_prior._build_longitudinal: already has good comments; add 'theta_P_w_per_kg' as a variable alias in the comment/docstring to make the naming intent visible. m10-guard-test.title: Item 9: Write the output-level guard test in test_published_f1_data.py
m10-guard-test.imperative: TDD: (1) Write the test first in TestCarPriorIdealLap class, (2) run to see green (it exercises the real car_prior->CapabilityEnvelope->PhysicsSimulator path), (3) deliberately break it by bypassing the car_prior conversion (skip g->m/s² scaling), (4) show it red, (5) restore. The test: build a synthetic EstimateRecord with realistic RBR-level values (A0~3.2 g, A2~8e-5 1/(m/s)^2, cda_closed~0.7m2, p_max~800000W, coast_theta_R~0.5, a_b~18, b_b~0.0035, a_t~10, b_t~0.004), build store_df from it, call build_car_ceiling, then simulate ideal lap on a simple track and assert: top_speed_kmh in [300, 360] and a representative corner cap in [15, 60] m/s. Run: py -m pytest tests/known_answer/test_published_f1_data.py -q

postconditions.statement: guard test green; deliberate-break shows red; restore shows green again; evidence captured

constraints: test-led for this item; no per-param band matrix; no units library; use car_prior path
